English district-court abbreviation for Haifa seen in Nevo English headers and legal-scholarship footnotes.

negative: Section 12 (TA) 1234/05 of the memo is blank.

note: Court-type abbreviation then district in parentheses then docket. Docket may be n/yy or the post-2012 NNNNN-MM-YY form. No source was fetched; abbreviations are from recollection of Israeli practice.
